purpose: single CPU feasibility smoke for a joint per-50-bin frame-set deletion model
adaptive_disclosure: created after independent-component and 92-feature contextual deletion heads showed no safe F5 signal
forbidden: source name, numeric source index, path, hash, or fold id as a model feature
threshold, model, feature, or route search on F5
inner_design: leave one of F1-F4 out; fit the single frozen model on the other three; pool only inner-held frame probabilities
prediction_unit: all retained C00 components in one 50-bin frame share one keep probability and one deletion decision

graph_contract.nearest_neighbor_engine: scipy.spatial.cKDTree with bounded k=1 or k=2 queries
graph_contract.path_edge: one nearest successor in the next bin within 6 pixels
graph_contract.complexity: O(C log C + E) with bounded nearest-neighbor output; no dense C-by-C matrix

feature_inputs: released raw-score-derived C00 scores, locations, component membership, and complete-video event_count only
label_use: train labels define whether a frame contains any retained target-support component; labels and target ids never enter features
selection_rule: minimum inner-family OOF probability among target-support frames; nonidentity selected only if every inner fold passes all official safety gates and pooled FP plus false-components strictly decrease
f5_access: F5 labels and metrics are opened only after the single model, inner OOF threshold, and identity-versus-nonidentity decision are fixed from F1-F4
stop_rule: if nonidentity is not selected by F1-F4 or the selected candidate fails any F5 gate or does not delete both FP events and false components, stop without full five-fold OOF
